assets.name: flow
assets.prompt: Edit this Wishfire FLOW navigation badge. Preserve its simple chunky cartoon style, thick dark outline, gold genie lamp, cyan/blue smoke, transparent alpha and no characters or text. Improve silhouette for 40-50px display: make the thick smoke sweep from the spout UP and AROUND the lamp in a broad nearly circular C-shaped curl, across the top and down the left, framing the lamp like a big magical halo with open negative space. Enlarge smoke into a substantial single ribbon, no wispy details or little swirls. Raise the lamp body into the middle of the composition; balance visual mass vertically, broad square compact silhouette occupying 85-90% image. Keep only a few flat color blocks with one cel shadow and broad highlight. The smoke and lamp should read as one strong centered emblem rather than a low lamp with a thin isolated question-mark plume. No enclosing frame or extra objects.
